summary: P1 meets its outcome: a read-only homelab_s3_reader and an opt-in, owner-signed reader grant that is inert without a configured reader, with protocol-level tests proving the no-ask and no-reader cases plan no change. Two advisory test gaps on paths the code handles correctly today.

findings.summary: No test covers granting a bucket added to an already-granted release; a planBuckets->stateBuckets mutation survives the suite.
Create's no-reader guard is untested; removing HasReader from Create survives the suite (only Update's no-reader path is covered).
